name: Missing-Pattern Conflict Graphs Are Monotone under Elementary Images
statement: For a nonempty ample family, the full missing-pattern conflict graph of every projection, coordinate conditioning, or full reduction is isomorphic to a subgraph of the original conflict graph. Its maximum degree therefore cannot increase, and the degree-at-most-one realization criterion is preserved under these operations and their compositions.
proof: Use the exact signed-route formulas and choose one parent route for every surviving or trimmed image route. Distinct image routes have distinct parents because every parent has a unique trim. Any conflict at a visible coordinate was already a conflict between the chosen parents, giving an edge-preserving injection. Iteration handles compositions; an empty image has only the empty pattern and no edges.
